title: Egyptian-Style Stewed Beans with Aromatic Spices
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Egypt, made with aromatic spices and navy beans.

ingredients.name: Egyptian aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add aromatic spices, cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste, cook for 1 minute.
Add navy beans, broth, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Check for seasoning and adjust as needed.
Serve hot, with lemon wedges on the side if desired.
